why: The people line's rows (#41), no scene's inventory: a line no place owns (no_place), so no owner's approval and no scene schema; the Pixal3D batch refuses it, so each look's take is made by its own take row (people-take-<look>). Each look one row, its words its take's. No concept view and no box: each look's close-up is drawn by its take row in SOMA-X's bind pose. No size yet: none is measured, so the close-up gate names each row's proportions unmeasured.
